en.text:
Passive grants the following benefits:
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness
• 25% increased Blink distance
• 20% decreased Blink cooldown (3.55s⁠🠚⁠2.85s)
• 30% decreased Blink activation delay (1.65s⁠🠚⁠1.15s)
• Removes Super Energy cost of <void/>Nova Warp's Dark Blink


While Blink is equipped, gain a horizontal 'Dark Blink' bound to your [Air Move]. Movement is identical to Nova Warp's Dark Blink, which spawns <pve 4 /> <pvp [2] /> <void/>Weakening Seekers that scale with the Super stat. Incurs a <pve 6 /> <pvp [8] /> second cooldown on use.

Blinking or casting Dark Blink grants 100 Handling for 2 seconds, <void/>Volatile Rounds for <pve 9 /> <pvp [5] /> seconds, and the Radar remains active during the animation.

Enemies within 10? meters become <void/>Volatile when initiating Blink.
